issues.description: Return-type mismatch for the method Milkable.messageOnMilk(): the problem statement (UML and textual description) declares messageOnMilk() to return a boolean (true/false), but the solution repository defines the interface method as returning String and the concrete classes (Seal, Goat) implement and return descriptive Strings. This discrepancy will confuse students about which signature to implement and can cause compilation/test mismatches depending on which artifact they follow.
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the method signature consistent across all artifacts. Two viable options:
1) Update the problem statement (UML and textual description) to declare messageOnMilk(): String and adjust the textual guidance to state it should return a descriptive message (e.g. "Goat <name> is milked"). This aligns with the existing solution implementation and example Main usage.
2) OR change the solution and any tests to use boolean messageOnMilk() and update Seal/Goat implementations to return true/false as described. If choosing this, also update Main and any example outputs accordingly.
Recommendation: prefer Option 1 (update problem statement) because the provided solution and implementations already use String return values and Main prints the returned value.
